audit.whatIsWrong: Chart reads [Shen, Skill, Mordekaiser x5] on both layers. Packet levelChart is [Skill, Mordekaiser, Mordekaiser, Shen, Mordekaiser, Shen, Shen], and the page's own prose agrees with the packet at every disputed row: whys[0] 'just farm even', whys[1] 'out-trades him', whys[5] 'without your R up he trades you even', whys[6] 'He out-values you long-term'.
audit.why: Shen has no early all-in, so Level 1 is even and Levels 2-3 belong to Mordekaiser's banked W plus a single-target Obliterate. From 4-5 onward Spirit's Refuge blanking autos on a 16-10s cycle plus matched tank scaling stabilises him, and Stand United is map value Mordekaiser's 650-range R cannot answer.
audit.corrected: Level 1 Skill, Level 2 Mordekaiser, Level 3 Mordekaiser, Levels 4-5 Shen, Level 6 Mordekaiser, First item Shen, 2+ items Shen. Matched full/content pairs with ratings.

audit.why: Four spikes present and real: Lvl 2-3 Q+W, Lvl 6 Realm of Death (140/120/100s), 1st item, and Shen's late Stand United map spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every reference to Shadow Dash and Spirit's Refuge is generic ('His engage CC. Dodge it.') with no range and no cooldown, and breakdown.cooldowns lists Shadow Dash twice under two spellings. The two facts that actually decide the lane are unstated: Shadow Dash is Shen's ONLY mobility (600 range, 18/16/14/12/10s), and Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks only — it does nothing to Obliterate.
audit.why: This is what makes the advice actionable: you poke Q through the W zone instead of feeding autos into it, and you commit the moment his E is spent because he has no second escape from a 700-range Death's Grasp.
audit.corrected: Shadow Dash: 600-range dash taunt, 18/16/14/12/10s, his only mobility. Spirit's Refuge: 400-range zone, 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s, blocks attacks near his blade — not spells. Twilight Assault is max-health damage on 8-5s. Stand United is a 200/180/160s global channel.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers on the punish window; breakdown.cooldowns duplicates the same ability.
audit.why: Shadow Dash 18-10s and Spirit's Refuge 16-10s are the two clocks.
audit.corrected: Commit once Shadow Dash is spent (18-10s) and after his W zone expires (16-10s).

audit.why: The packet's three suspectNames — 'Bait Spirit's Refuge', 'Use Spirit's Refuge', 'His Shadow Dash' — are all FALSE POSITIVES. Spirit's Refuge and Shadow Dash are the real Riot names for Shen's W and E; the checker matched on the leading word, not on a misspelling.
audit.corrected: No name change needed. Do not 'fix' these.

notes: The packet's three suspectNames on this matchup are false positives — Spirit's Refuge and Shadow Dash are the correct Riot names and should be left alone; the checker fired on the preceding word. Same recurring data bug as the other mordekaiser matchups: champ-data/_kits/mordekaiser.json carries a grounding flag ('shuts off enemy dashes') on Obliterate that Riot's own Obliterate description does not support, so I made no claim about Q denying Shadow Dash even though it would be the most valuable line in this matchup if true — worth a human ruling.
